attchmntText: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 447382 Equity Shares pursuant to exercise of ESOPs.
voiceSummary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has allotted 4,47,382 equity shares of Rs. 10 each on November 12, 2026. This allotment was made to eligible option holders who exercised their stock options under the Aadhar Housing Finance Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2020. The newly issued shares rank pari passu with existing equity shares in all aspects. As a result of this transaction, the company's paid-up equity share capital has increased to Rs. 4,38,84,05,390. This total capital corresponds to 43,88,40,539 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10 each. The event occurred on November 12, 2026, at 12.15 pm. The intimation was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI regulations. Rajesh Viswanathan, Chief Financial Officer, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported AUM of INR32,643 crores with 18% year-on-year growth. Disbursements for Q2 stood at INR2,577 crores, showing 22% year-on-year growth. Net profit for the quarter was INR308 crores, up from INR266 crores in the same period last year. H1 net profit reached INR591 crores. Gross NPA was 1.34%. The company expanded its branch network to 632 branches across 23 states. Rating agencies upgraded the company's long-term rating to AA+ stable. Shri Deo Shankar Tripathi was appointed Interim Non-Executive Chairman following the demise of Shri Raj Vikash Verma. Shri Nikhil Goyal joined the Board as Additional Director. The RBI increased the repo rate to 5.5%.

attchmntText: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - Unaudited Financial Results for quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited filed newspaper clippings of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, published on November 07, 2026. Voltas Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, on November 06, 2026. Anjum Abdul Latif Kazi reported loss of share certificate number 350462 for 300 shares. Black Rose Industries Limited reported total income of 8,768.35 lakh and net profit of 1,048.73 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Aspira Pathlab and Diagnostics Limited reported net loss of 115.95 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Nomura Fixed Income Securities Limited reported net profit of 401.8 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
